pageDescription: Record and manage your game clips with hardware-accelerated capture
replayRamWarning: Buffers above 5 minutes use a lot of RAM. Make sure your system has enough memory.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this clip?
audioFallbackDesc: Could not capture the game's audio individually. All system audio is being recorded. Close unnecessary programs to avoid background noise.
memoryMBDesc: Capture engine RAM usage (live replay buffer footprint)
watchdogFailedDesc: The engine watchdog detected a pipeline failure (backend switch or stalled export). Capture paths were adjusted automatically.
audioSessionsTooltip: Limits the recording audio to one selected app and its sub-processes. Leave the list empty to capture all system audio again.
audioSessionsHint: Pick ONE app: only its audio (and sub-processes) is captured. Others stay out. Empty list = capture all system audio.
deleteMultipleConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the selected clips?
saveClipDesc: Saves the clip from the replay buffer (last seconds)
toggleMicDesc: Toggles the microphone on or off during recording
pushToTalkDesc: Toggles the Push-to-Talk mode for the microphone
pushToTalkTooltip: Push-to-Talk: the microphone only captures audio while a chosen key is held (Hold mode) or toggles on/off each press (Toggle mode).
autoStartCaptureDesc: When a game is detected, automatically start recording
mergeHint: Add clips to merge (select multiple from the grid first)
needTwoClips: Need at least 2 clips to merge
droppedFramesTooltip: Frames dropped during this capture session. 'GPU' indicates drops caused by a busy encoder (gpuBusyDrops).
stretchToFitTooltip: Stretches the image to fill the full 16:9 frame, removing black bars (letterboxing). Disables aspect ratio preservation — may distort the image if the game runs at a different resolution.
sharpnessTooltip: Applies contrast adaptive sharpening (ffmpeg cas) to the recorded image. 0 disables the filter; higher values sharpen edges, which can help low-bitrate or upscaled captures look crisper.
replayBufferModeTooltip: Controls where the replay buffer lives. RAM: keeps everything in memory (limited window). Hybrid: ~3 min of video in RAM, the rest spills to disk (audio is always in memory). Disk only: virtually zero RAM — video and audio stream to disk; saving may take longer, but hardware (RAM/disk/CPU) stays stable even in long sessions.
tooltipQuality: Sets video quality. Higher quality = larger files. CQ controls compression (lower = better).
tooltipGpu: GPU used for recording. Select if you have more than one GPU in your system.
tooltipResolution: Recorded video size. Higher resolution = more quality and more disk space.
tooltipFps: Frames per second. 60 FPS is ideal for games. 30 FPS saves space.
tooltipReplay: How much gameplay is kept in memory for saving clips. More time uses more RAM.
tooltipMic: Records microphone audio along with game video.
tooltipLoopback: Records system audio (game, Discord, browser) along with the video.
tooltipSampleRate: Audio sample rate. 48kHz is standard for videos. 96kHz for high-quality audio.
tooltipGameAudio: Only records game and microphone audio, muting other apps (Discord, browser, etc).
tooltipNoiseSuppression: Reduces microphone background noise using built-in audio filters (anlmdn/arnndn). Helps eliminate keyboard, fan, or ambient noise.
tooltipAdaptiveQuality: Automatically tunes recording to available RAM: lighter profile (CQ, resolution, bitrate) at start when memory is tight, and during recording it gradually shrinks the replay window in steps when RAM gets critical, restoring it once memory stabilizes. Disable for maximum quality at all times.
reEncodeTooltip: Re-encodes the trimmed segment to remove macroblocks/artifacts left by the fast copy. Slower but cleaner output.
enhanceTooltip: Uses AMD VCN Super Resolution (sr_amf) to upscale the clip and/or AMD Fluid Motion Frames (frc_amf) to double the frame rate. Requires an AMD GPU with VCN. Only available when re-encoding.
enhanceUnavailable: AMD enhance (sr_amf/frc_amf) requires an AMD GPU with VCN — not detected on this machine.
ramPressureCriticalDesc: RAM usage is at {{pct}}%. Replay buffer was reduced to keep recording stable.
expiryWarning: The link expires after 10 days without downloads and downloads are free with ads.
